nature_language: 当前位置广州。我一个人想去南京玩2天，预算3000人民币，坐火车去，住一间单床房，想去历史古迹，请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Guangzhou. I want to travel alone to Nanjing for 2 days with a budget of 3000 RMB. I plan to take the train and stay in a single room. I would like to visit historical sites. Please provide me with a travel itinerary.
